newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RTZ-CRA says not anxious to buy.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RTZ-CRA says not anxious to buy.

text.p: Anglo-Australian miing giant RTZ-CRA chief executive Leon Davis said on Wednesday the mining giant would not rely on acquisitions to fuel its long-term growth.

"We have the luxury, I guess, of being such a large organisation with so many long-life, low-cost mines that there is no imperative for us to go out there to keep the business surviving," he told a news conference.
The company, which plans to change its name to Rio Tinto, earlier announced a restructure into commodity-based divisions.
Davis said the group's other growth strategies included continued exploration, brownfields expansion of existing businesses and technological innovation.
He said RTZ-CRA continued to watch for acquisition opportunities, but added the company had a history of bidding low to sieze value.

"We're always looking for acquisitions. We haven't been successful because we pitch our prices too low. This is because we have a very strong belief that it's no good overpaying for assets if the returns to shareholders are not there," he said.
